title: The Zero Tech Debt Mandate
facebook_comment_text: 👇 Tech debt isn't just a one-time cost; it's like a high-interest loan that compounds daily. Every hurried fix or skipped test adds to a burden that eventually cripples your ability to adapt and innovate. It’s not just about upgrades, but about business agility itself. How has accumulated tech debt directly impacted your strategic roadmap or market responsiveness?
